Optimization_Justification: Replaces 350 EGP Arduino UNO Rev3 board with bare surface-mount MCU (saves 90 EGP)
Replaces 150 EGP keypad shield by eliminating shield carrier PCB and 4 unused buttons
Two dedicated buttons for LL and LH instead of full 5-key resistor ladder
Volume pricing improves further on our 70 EGP retail price (down from 90 EGP)
Provides accurate external clock required by ATmega328P without UNO board
Steps down 12V vehicle accessory rail to regulated 5V logic supply
Protects standalone HMI electronics against reverse polarity and voltage spikes
Replaces 8 EGP through-hole LED and discrete axial resistor with automated SMD parts
Volume buzzer (vs 10 EGP retail) with transistor driver protecting PD2 I/O pin
Replaces onboard shield contrast trimmer potentiometer on custom PCB
Enables factory ISP firmware flashing without permanent USB-UART bridge IC
Eliminates 60 EGP jumper wires and 65 EGP breadboard for vibration-safe mounting

column9: Reduces unit cost by 238.50 EGP (~33.4%) vs 714.00 EGP prototype
